question: Should ClawHub continue the current dual-compiler transition, or intentionally migrate every required `tsc` validation path to TypeScript 7 in a dedicated change?
rationale: The dependency bot cannot choose the permanent compiler strategy, and current main deliberately keeps TypeScript 6 for classic checks while exposing TypeScript 7 through the native alias.

options.title: Keep dual compilers
options.body: Retain TypeScript 6 for `tsc`, keep TypeScript 7 under `@typescript/native`, and reject unrelated lockfile drift.

options.title: Sponsor TypeScript 7 migration
options.body: Replace the compatibility compiler only through a dedicated migration that updates scripts and configuration and proves every required validation path.

options.title: Defer the major bump
options.body: Close or pause this bot PR if maintainers do not want to choose and validate the compiler transition now.

recommendation.title: Keep dual compilers
recommendation.body: Retain TypeScript 6 for `tsc`, keep TypeScript 7 under `@typescript/native`, and reject unrelated lockfile drift.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to integrating CI and type-fix changes on main.
